description: Field.AppendChunk on a Memo field and then on a Text field (read-write copy of r-wire-blank): on a dynaset of SELECT ID, FMemo, FText FROM W, thirteen rows each AddNew, ID = n, AppendChunk on FMemo of: 1 "abc", 2 U+0000 inside, 3 BSTR of 1 byte, 4 BSTR of 3 bytes, 5 lone high surrogate, 6 "ab" then odd BSTR then "cd", 7 UI1 array of four bytes, 8 Null, 9 Empty, 10 Missing, 11 I4, 12 empty BSTR, 13 300 characters; Update. Rows 21 to 23: AppendChunk on FText of "abc", an odd BSTR and a UI1 array. Then each Memo row re-read with FieldSize and GetChunk(0, 40) through FindFirst, and the table read once. Asks the HRESULT of each step, stored values, sizes and BSTR byte lengths.
retentionNote: Designed r-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
